reason: I grab my caffeine at petrol stations or order pre-workout from GymBeam, and this isn't sold either place, so I'm not ordering a can of fancy mate from a separate e-shop. Before training a coffee or water does the job anyway.
objection: Why pay 55 CZK for 80 mg of caffeine in a can when coffee or matcha does the same thing, and I can't even buy it where I actually stop.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at the petrol stations I stop at, or on Vilgain or GymBeam so I could add it to an order I'm already making.
